description: pyOpenRiverCam is LocalDevices and contributors' Python library for image-based river-flow analysis. It reads video frames, reprojects them to the water surface and uses large-scale particle image velocimetry to estimate velocities. Inputs are OpenCV-compatible video, camera metadata and a surveyed cross-section; outputs include velocity fields, discharge estimates and geographic or camera-view plots. Spatial resolution is user-defined, while coverage and sampling follow the camera footage. Source is free under AGPL-3.0, with public API documentation and installation instructions. A limitation is that poor weather, night-time imagery and conditions unsuitable for particle tracking need careful treatment; alternative STIV processing is described as future work. The observations can calibrate or check river and flood-defence simulations. RiverREM (platform-riverrem) supplies related channel-terrain preparation. The README illustrates the Ngwerere River in Lusaka. No river video, software package or camera system was accessed.
